Class MouseShadow

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.window.input.MouseShadow
public final class MouseShadow extends Object
Temporary GUI-coordinate override used by the HEI mouse helper mixin.

HEI's normal helper reads the main window. A hosted action instead publishes its pointer and drawable dimensions here, then clears the active marker. This is client-thread global state with one slot, not a nested or thread-local stack.
